exact_items: Runtime_Artifacts_Panel.md calls artifact_id, run_id, thread_id, task_id, linked_artifact_id, and logical_artifact_id the canonical ID set, but that set is still missing the attempt-native/runtime attribution fields the rest of the rewrite now depends on
the docs still use task_id language in the artifact packet even though wider execution identity is moving toward node/package/seam/lane-native structures
Treat task_id as legacy/compatibility display metadata where necessary, not the main execution anchor
notes: task_id must be demoted to legacy/compatibility metadata; attempt_id, node_id, execution_role, provider_attempt_ref must be added to canonical ID set

exact_items: Promote the runtime-artifact envelope from a named schema file to a clearly stated common field contract in Runtime_Artifacts_Panel.md
Make the envelope explicitly attempt-native and bridge-aware
the runtime-artifact envelope should be attempt-native by default
notes: The missing piece is 'the common envelope contract is underspecified', not 'we need schemas'. artifact_id identifies the artifact object, not the runtime attempt.

exact_items: FileManager.md still states one canonical open contract: OpenFile { path: PathBuf, line?, range?, target_group? } — but its later addenda already require a second category of opens
Split FileManager's canonical open contract into: workspace path open, identity-native subject open
Reuse the preview subject identity pattern (doc: / artifact:) as the base instead of inventing a separate parallel scheme
notes: FileManager needs two contracts: OpenFile { path } for workspace-file opens; OpenSubject { subject_id } for attempt/artifact/safe_point/remediation/generated opens. subject_id families: doc:, artifact:, attempt:, safe_point:, remediation:, scheduler_pass:

exact_items: FileManager.md needs open-by-identity and generated non-repo drafts
OpenFile { path: PathBuf } plus root-path validation cannot satisfy it; no OpenArtifact-style contract, no evidence_by_attempt projection, and no artifact-index freshness/degraded fallback exist
Align FileManager open-by-identity requirements with the runtime-artifact envelope rather than inventing a parallel artifact-opening identity model
notes: FileManager.md addendum requires open-by-identity for: attempt-scoped evidence by attempt_id, safe-point manifests by safe_point_id, remediation lineage by remediation_root_id, generated non-repo drafts, runtime artifacts by artifact_id

exact_items: FinalGUISpec.md still states one unified OpenFile { path... } contract for all file-open actions across the app
FinalGUISpec.md still overstates the scope of OpenFile by claiming all file-open actions across the app use that one contract, even though the app now needs identity-native subject opens
Update FinalGUISpec.md so OpenFile remains true for workspace files, while identity-native opens route through OpenSubject under the same higher-level routing model
notes: FinalGUISpec.md OpenFile overclaim: it claims to handle all file-open actions; must be narrowed to workspace files only, with identity-native opens routing through OpenSubject

exact_items: there is currently no canonical OpenArtifact/OpenSubject contract even though multiple docs implicitly need it
generated://<artifact_id> exists in preview restore behavior, but that identity pattern has not yet been generalized for other artifact/report opens
notes: OpenSubject / OpenArtifact contract shape has no canonical owner doc yet; Contracts_V0.md is the recommended home

exact_items: Add a canonical route payload / target model owner section, likely in Contracts_V0.md or an equivalent routing owner doc
define one canonical internal route/target payload for navigation
resume_url should be one serialized transport form of that payload
notes: Contracts_V0.md or equivalent routing owner doc must own a canonical route target payload used by command palette, search, artifact deep-links, blocked notices, FileManager/Editor opens

exact_items: Introduce explicit subject-open command coverage in the command catalog instead of overloading path-open semantics everywhere
add a small canonical navigation/open family for target resolution: cmd.nav.open_subject, cmd.nav.open_usage_subject, cmd.nav.focus_route, or an equivalent compact family
notes: UI_Command_Catalog.md needs a canonical cmd.nav.* family: cmd.nav.open_subject (resolves file/document/artifact/generated/report targets), cmd.nav.focus_route (restores page/tab/run context), cmd.nav.open_usage_subject (resolves Usage/Ledger identity from usage_event_ref)
